'''''Mystic Corellia''''' was a decorative poster available in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] sometime after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] between the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]]. It depicted the silhouettes of two [[sharnaff]], a [[Species/Legends|species]] found on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]], at a waterfront. One of the creatures had lowered its head to drink from the [[Water/Legends|water]] while the other looked off to the right. The poster was [[Color/Legends|colored]] in sepia shades and written on it in large [[Aurebesh/Legends|Aurebesh]] letters, the [[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|Galactic Basic Standard]] alphabet, were the words "Mystic Corellia", while text at the bottom listed several cities of Corellia: [[Coronet/Legends|Coronet]], [[Tyrena/Legends|Tyrena]], [[Bela Vistal/Legends|Bela Vistal]], [[Kor Vella/Legends|Kor Vella]] and [[Doaba Guerfel/Legends|Doaba Guerfel]].<ref name="SWG" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Gayle_Ullman_Mystic_South_Africa.jpg|thumb|left|150px|The original: ''Mystic South Africa'' by Gayle Ullman.]]
''Mystic Corellia'' appeared in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|MMORPG]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'' developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]]. It was one of three "chapter gifts" given out randomly to every player that logged in during the release of ''Chapter 1: The Corellian Captives'' on [[June 8]], [[2006]]. The player would receive a "rolled up poster" item upon logging in and when used, would randomly award you one of the three posters. The other posters of the three were ''[[Survive The Rryatt Trail]]'' and ''[[It Came From Mustafar!]]''. The player could use the poster as decoration in their house.<ref name="SWG" /> The poster shared visual similarities with the real-world poster "''Mystic South Africa''" by artist Gayle Ullman.<ref name="Ullman">{{WebCite|url=http://www.allposters.com/-sp/Mystic-South-Africa-Posters_i311327_.htm|text=''Mystic South Africa'' Prints by Gayle Ullman|work=AllPosters.com|archivedate=20060228172245}}</ref>
